prompt: could you give some activities one could do with kids when the weather is bad
response: When the weather is bad, it's a great time to get creative indoors! You could try baking cookies or making homemade playdough. Another idea is to set up an indoor treasure hunt with clues hidden around the house. Building a fort out of pillows and blankets is also a lot of fun. If you're feeling really adventurous, you could even try crafting with recyclable materials. These activities are not only fun but also help develop important skills like problem-solving and creativity.
